purpose: Per-dataset U25 gates (readiness key, observation-selection files) and per-package integrity/reproduction recipes. Values are transcribed from each package's own files; nothing here supplies a scientific value or an expected outcome.
dataset_scope: The datasets declared in required_data by the U contracts that list U25 as a predecessor (parsed at run time by package_verification.declared_datasets). D01-D03 are not declared by any such contract and are therefore not registered; a later declaration needs a reviewed entry here.
observation_dataset_rule: Roadmap C8: observation tests need a committed calibration/hold-out split frozen before final scoring. observation_dataset=true for packages scored against AMPS in I32-I40 (D07, D08, D09, D12, D13, D14, D15); false for laboratory/reference data and forcing inputs (D04, D05, D06, D10, D11).
frozen_selection_rule: A selection is accepted as frozen only if its status value is listed in frozen_status_values. No package has frozen its split as of 2026-11-23, so every list is empty and the gate fails closed; add the package's frozen value here only after it is reviewed.
unregistered_verification_rule: verification=null means no integrity/reproduction recipe has been reviewed. Such a dataset is SKIPPED if it ever passes the readiness and selection gates, never PASS.

photochemistry.ignored_names_reason: .venv is the package's interpreter environment (created after SHA256SUMS.txt, not part of the data); __pycache__ is Python bytecode. Neither is listed in SHA256SUMS.txt.

reproduction.documented_in: photochemistry/README.md: '.venv/bin/python scripts/run_photochemistry_pipeline.py --skip-fetch' processes the acquired immutable raw data without network access
reproduction.verified_2026_11_23: A trial rerun on a copy reproduced all 206 raw/processed/inventory/documentation files byte for byte; provenance.json, qa_report.json and qa_report.txt differed only in generated_utc / 'Generated UTC:'.
